title: Itsuka, Nemuri ni Tsuku Hi
synonyms: Someday, the day go to sleep
synopsis: Hotaru Morino is a second year high school student who has had an unrequited crush on Ren Otaka since junior high school. One day, while on a school trip with Ren and her good friend Shiori Yamamoto, their bus gets into an accident. When Hotaru wakes up, a young man who is dressed fully in black appears in front of her. He is Kuro, a grim reaper. A shocked Hotaru shoves him away but he has shocking words for her: "I'm your guide. Hotaru Morino, listen carefully. You're dead." Hotaru learns that if she does not get over her attachment to three things within 49 days, she will end up becoming a ghost bound to a specific physical location and wouldn't be able to rest in peace. She had slept for one month after the accident and has only 19 days left. And so, Hotaru sets out to settle the three lingering regrets with the limited time she has, in the company of Kuro. One of them is to confess her feelings to Ren, her crush of five years. However, when he is in front of her, she finds it impossible to tell him how she feels. As Hotaru settles her first lingering regret, dark clouds begin to gather over her and Kuro...

titleRomaji: Seijo no Ane Desu ga, Imouto no Tame no Tokushu Maseki ya Tokushu Yakusou no Saishu wo Yametara, Ringoku no Majutsushi-sama no Moto de Shiawase ni Narimashita!
titleNative: 聖女の姉ですが、妹のための特殊魔石や特殊薬草の採取をやめたら、隣国の魔術師様の元で幸せになりました！
synopsis: The main character, a young girl named Sherry, is an excellent "gatherer" who collects special herbs and magic stones. She became a gatherer to help her only relative, her younger sister Irene, a saint, but when Irene comes of age and is engaged, she abandons her and tells her to disappear somewhere. Sherry decides to leave her country and heads for the neighboring Rogue Kingdom, where magic is thriving. Along the way, she meets Aslan, a handsome magician from the Rogue Kingdom... This is the Cinderella story of a gathering nerd who turns her life around. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Candy Candy
titleNative: キャンディ・キャンディ
synopsis: This story is about a girl, Candy, who is a orphan. She is a nice and optimistic girl and she has a warm heart. When she was a child, she lived in an orphanage called Pony's Home. She had a good friend called Annie. And she met the "Prince of the Hill" who is a important person in her life, on the hill behind the orphanage. She was adopted by the Leagan's family. What's awaiting her are the bad-hearted Neil and his sister, Eliza. One day, in the rose garden, she met a boy, who is identical to the "Prince of the Hill" who she had met in her childhood. The boy is called Anthony. Thereafter, a fantastic story that she has never expected begins. (Source: AnimeNfo) Note: Won the 1st Kodansha Manga Award for shoujo in 1977.

A Relaxed Life of Gathering Materials in Another World
synopsis: The protagonist, Sozai Shu, a 26-year-old single man, is a gamer with a natural collecting habit. After losing his life in the joy of obtaining a rare material in a game, he is transported to another world by the power of God. In order to make life in the other world easier, Shu prays to God for the "power to gather materials at his own pace!" His wish is granted, but somehow the power is strangely strong and convenient!? In a different world full of unknown materials, Shu struggles to gather various materials in order to live a rich and relaxed life of gathering materials! (Source: Amazon Japan, translated)
